column1: # Spellings of one name or word that differ between the Dizionario di Teologia Biblica (1976) and the
# CEI 2008 text and its notes (session F2, from R3 E2): the explorer's search looks for every form of a
# group when one is typed, and says which other forms it found. Seeded from the alignment of the
# indices with the dictionary (allineamenti.tsv: Melchìsedek / MELCHISEDECH) and from a comparison of
# the proper names of the two texts (a dictionary word absent from the Bible, a Bible word absent from
# the dictionary, at most two letters apart), reviewed one by one; forms without accents, lower case.
